source.name: BNC/COCA Level 6 word family lists, version 1.0.0 (2017)
source.attribution: Nation, I.S.P. (2017). The BNC/COCA Level 6 word family lists (Version 1.0.0) [Data file]. Victoria University of Wellington / Te Herenga Waka. Normalized for EnglishPilot from the official publisher download.
source.modification: Converted the first 25 frequency-band files to lowercase UTF-8 JSON; removed BOM and formatting whitespace; grouped indented family members under their source headword; retained source family order and band assignment. Omitted zero padding, Range software, five placeholder files, and four supplementary lists. No definitions, phonetics, or examples added.

The data uses the hub's CC BY-SA terms; the software alternative on that hub is GNU GPL v2/v3. No separate per-file license was found in the archive.

licenseEvidence.quote: Range with 25,000 words from the BNC/COCA lists (version 1.0.0)

licenseEvidence.note: Official 2018 documentation identifies the 2017 Level 6 version 1.0.0, 25 frequency lists plus four supplements, and citation. It contains no additional per-file license assignment.

warnings: The license is evidenced by the publisher's resource-hub grant, not an embedded per-file LICENSE. The hub also names GNU GPL v2/v3 as appropriate to the resource.
Only numbered frequency lists 1–25 are included. Files 26–30 contain fake Range placeholders, not vocabulary bands; lists 31–34 are supplements and excluded.
All frequency suffixes in this v1.0.0 archive are zero padding. They were not interpreted as word-frequency measurements.
BOM removed from: basewrd5.txt, basewrd18.txt, basewrd19.txt. Unicode spelling is preserved, including führer, fainéant, and musée.
This is reference vocabulary-family data without definitions, phonetics, translations, examples, or an exam syllabus mapping.
WordFamilyFinder v1.3.0 is a different data version and was not merged into these 25,000 families.
